name: exact-sstm-incompressible-to-compressible-relative-diagnostic
objective: Isolate the effect of changing the accepted exact NASA SSTm NACA 0012 solution from incompressible simpleFoam with constant nu to compressible rhoSimpleFoam with a perfect-gas energy equation and exact Sutherland transport, while preserving mesh, velocity, Mach, Reynolds number, turbulence equations, overlapping convection schemes, overlapping relaxation factors, and force conventions.
validation_status: planned_diagnostic_only; strict Gate 4 remains downstream of failed Gate 1
fixed_invariants: NASA TMR altered closed NACA 0012 897x257 mesh and every polyMesh file
alpha=0 deg and freestream velocity 51.4815 m/s
freestream kinematic viscosity 8.58e-6 m2/s and chord Reynolds number 6000174.825
TmrSSTmExactProduction equations, coefficients, and turbulent Prandtl number 0.9
final U, k, omega, and nut internal fields from the accepted incompressible source
linearUpwind U convection and bounded upwind k and omega convection
overlapping p, U, k, and omega relaxation factors
force axes, reference area, reference length, quarter-chord center, and freestream dynamic-pressure normalization

declared_changes.pressure: kinematic gauge p to absolute thermodynamic p using p_abs = 101325 Pa + rho_inf*p_kinematic

predeclared_outputs.primary_effect: mean Cd(compressible exact SSTm) minus mean Cd(incompressible exact SSTm) over each final 100-iteration window
predeclared_outputs.settling: final-100 peak-to-peak <= max(0.001, 1% of absolute coefficient mean)
predeclared_outputs.trend: projected absolute change over 500 iterations within Cd 0.0002, Cl 0.004, and CmPitch 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.residuals: final-100 maximum initial residual <= 1e-5 for p, Ux, Uy, e, k, and omega
predeclared_outputs.zero_angle_symmetry: absolute mean Cl <= 0.004 and absolute mean quarter-chord CmPitch <= 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.force_agreement: absolute mean Cd minus NASA CFL3D SST Cd <= 0.0002

decision_rule: Retain and report the compressible result regardless of NASA force agreement. The diagnostic rung passes only if provenance, invariant, runtime, exact-model selection, thermodynamic mapping, finite-history, horizon, settling, trend, residual, and symmetry gates pass. Strict validation remains blocked by failed Gate 1 and no coefficient is accepted for rocket design.
